publication: Samuel R. Buss, On Herbrand’s Theorem, Logic and Computational Complexity, LNCS960 (1995), pp.195–209; 15-page author-paper copy.

reviews.checked_passages: §2 pp.2–3 Theorem1 and existential witness extraction, including witness-set union needed for contraction. Author erratum webpage and McKinley arXiv1007.3414v1 pp.1–2 inspected to separate the defective general theorem proof from the adopted weak fragment.
reviews.consumers: Corpus adoption at the linked weak extraction invariant, existential step, tuple certificate and leading-universal parameter blocks. Adoption is restricted to leading existential blocks with quantifier-free matrices and their leading-universal version; the defective general proof is not used.
reviews.outcome: The weak existential/universal-existential extraction is adopted with a complete local algorithm and proof. The author confirms a defect in the §3 proof of the general theorem; [BUSS-HERBRAND-01](source-errors/findings/BUSS-HERBRAND-01.json) records the restriction-on-contraction gap. No general Herbrand expansion proof is adopted; the theorem itself remains true and deep contraction provides a repair.
